entry.title: Hermann Castle

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: The inspected aerial picture confirms the white tower, timber hoarding, steep red gable, inward red roof ring and small turret. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained site outline set approximate location and river-facing orientation. Convent working floor rises0.8m; foundations extend into the coarse riverbank. Broad lawn geometry is omitted from the derivative so actual viewer terrain supplies the yards; low exterior paving follows coarse ground. Anchor 28.200695255,59.375639522; heading 0.198046850682; standard PMTiles datum 25.698401887691865m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
